title: Altıntepe, 425 miles away, shares the same symbols

tellings.quote: there's a site called Alton Tepe mhm you ready for this 425 miles away from the other sites

plain: An ancient site in Turkey called Altıntepe is said to share the same carved symbols as a group of other ancient sites, even though it lies about 425 miles away from them. The researcher Matt LaCroix brings this up in his talk with Michels about something big that he believes happened around 12,000 BC, without naming a source. If true, it would mean the same set of symbols spread much farther than people usually assume.
